_meta.title: P3 alternative backup: scenario chance-constrained MIP + rolling horizon
_meta.protocol: corrected actual p=alpha*d+beta; C=s+p; device release=s+max(p,b); cost=2+0.1b+0.2D; admission s+b<=H and cost+c<=B
_meta.data: official tasks.csv + source_segment_index.csv; true durations resampled from the validation split with the official rng stream; seeds 2026111700..2026111729

params.residual_source: all 343 eligible segments (train+validation+test) of source_segment_index.csv, per family x prefix, 5%-95% quantile grid, ranks de-correlated per unit by crc32 so scenarios are not comonotone

edf_old.description: official p3_stochastic_schedule.py, policy edf_old (earliest due date, prediction-based reserve, paid review when it raises on-time probability)

slack_old.description: official p3_stochastic_schedule.py, policy slack_old (slack-weighted priority, adaptive reserve, pressure-triggered dropping)

ccmip_reserve.description: CC-MIP ordering by the median-scenario CP-SAT model (order only), reserve b_j solved from the chance constraint P(p_j > b_j) <= eps by empirical family x prefix quantiles, re-planned after every completion / paid observation (rolling)

ccmip_rolling.description: full joint CC-MIP: order, reserve b_j and paid observations all decided by the N-scenario CP-SAT model, re-solved after every completion / observation

ccmip_oneshot.description: same joint CC-MIP but solved once at t=0, never re-planned (ablation isolating the value of the rolling horizon)
